name: pr_diff
description: Return a PR's unified diff (capped) + changed files, via gh pr diff. Input: repo (owner/name or URL), number.

repo.description: GitHub repository (owner/name or URL) that owns the PR.

repoUrl.description: Alternate spelling for 'repo'; used when 'repo' is not supplied.

repoPath.description: Local checkout used as a fallback source for the diff when `gh pr diff` 406s on very large PRs (>300 files).

diff.description: Unified diff text, capped at 200,000 chars.

truncated.description: True when the diff exceeded the cap and was truncated.

diffSource.description: 'gh' when GitHub's API served the diff, 'local' when it fell back to a git diff against repoPath.
